topic: He’s bound to win, and she’s likely to lose
title: He’s bound to win, and she’s likely to lose
pt: Foco da aula: be bound to / be likely to / be sure to: probabilidade

lines.en: Mia, look at the crowd tonight. Our band is bound to be nervous, but the audience is likely to love us.
lines.pt: Mia, olhe a plateia hoje. Nossa banda com certeza vai ficar nervosa, mas o público provavelmente vai nos adorar.

lines.en: You always worry, Felix. The sound engineer says the new microphones are sure to work, and the lights are fixed.
lines.pt: Você sempre se preocupa, Felix. O técnico de som diz que os microfones novos com certeza vão funcionar, e as luzes estão consertadas.

lines.en: I hope so. Last year the speakers broke in the middle of the song, and the singer was furious.
lines.pt: Espero que sim. No ano passado as caixas de som quebraram no meio da música, e o cantor ficou furioso.

lines.en: This time we rehearsed for weeks. Our singer is bound to remember the ending, and he is unlikely to miss another cue.
lines.pt: Desta vez ensaiamos por semanas. Nosso cantor com certeza vai lembrar o final e dificilmente vai errar outra deixa.

lines.en: True, but the other band is very good. They are likely to win if the judges like loud guitars.
lines.pt: Verdade, mas a outra banda é muito boa. Eles provavelmente ganham se os jurados gostarem de guitarras altas.

lines.en: Maybe, though the judges are sure to notice how well we work together. That counts more than volume, I think.
lines.pt: Talvez, mas os jurados com certeza vão notar como trabalhamos bem juntos. Isso vale mais que volume, acho.

lines.en: You sound confident. Are you not afraid that you will forget the words in front of all these people?
lines.pt: Você parece confiante. Não tem medo de esquecer a letra na frente de todas essas pessoas?

lines.en: A little. When I feel nervous, I breathe slowly and look at the back of the room, not at faces.
lines.pt: Um pouco. Quando fico nervoso, respiro devagar e olho para o fundo da sala, não para os rostos.

lines.en: Good trick. If I do the same, I am likely to feel calmer, and my voice is bound to improve.
lines.pt: Bom truque. Se eu fizer o mesmo, provavelmente vou ficar mais calma, e minha voz com certeza vai melhorar.

lines.en: Exactly. Besides, the stage manager is calling us. Whatever happens, the crowd is sure to clap at the end.
lines.pt: Exato. Além disso, o diretor de palco está nos chamando. Aconteça o que acontecer, a plateia com certeza vai aplaudir no final.

lines.en: You are right. Let us go on stage, smile, and enjoy ourselves, because we are bound to remember tonight.
lines.pt: Você tem razão. Vamos para o palco, sorrir e nos divertir, porque com certeza vamos lembrar desta noite.

facts.label: Bound to, likely to, sure to
facts.sub: He is bound to win, and she is likely to lose.

facts.label: bound to + verbo
facts.sub: Be bound to expressa quase certeza: Our band is bound to be nervous. Também vale para o que é natural esperar: He is bound to forget.

facts.label: likely to + verbo
facts.sub: Be likely to é provável: They are likely to win. Para pouca chance, use be unlikely to: He is unlikely to miss another cue.

paragraphs: It is a warm night in Miami. A big music contest starts soon. Tess and Theo wait backstage. The hall is already full. Tess checks her guitar again. Theo tries to stay calm.

“Theo, look at the crowd tonight. Our band is bound to be nervous, but the audience is likely to love us.” says Tess. “You always worry, Tess. The sound engineer says the new microphones are sure to work, and the lights are fixed.” says Theo. “I hope so. Last year the speakers broke in the middle of the song, and the singer was furious.” says Tess.

You sound confident. Are you not afraid that you will forget the words in front of all these people?

You

Tess

You

Tess
